subject.title: Complementary tool: automated skill quality scoring for curation workflow

question: Should ClawHub endorse or integrate agent-skill-infra for curation, or first define a native advisory quality-signal contract independent of this CLI?
rationale: The remaining decision is not a narrow code fix: it affects third-party dependency endorsement, model-provider data handling, score authority, security semantics, and overlap with open quality/policy RFCs.

options.title: Define native contract first
options.body: Agree on advisory quality dimensions, provenance, freshness, privacy, and separation from ClawScan before choosing any implementation or external CLI integration.

options.title: Document as optional reviewer tool
options.body: Keep agent-skill-infra outside ClawHub runtime and publish guarded operator guidance if maintainers are comfortable with its dependency and data-handling model.

options.title: Decline endorsement for now
options.body: Leave the external CLI unsupported until the broader quality-signal and content-policy discussions converge.

recommendation.title: Define native contract first
recommendation.body: Agree on advisory quality dimensions, provenance, freshness, privacy, and separation from ClawScan before choosing any implementation or external CLI integration.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is CODEOWNERS-listed across the backend/security/CLI paths and current quality-path blame, making them the best routed owner for the product/security decision.
